actions.description: Select rows using custom SQL and insert into table in BigQuery
actions.help: Select rows in BigQuery with a Custom SQL and insert into table. Workato will wait up to 60 seconds for the query to run synchronously. For queries that take longer, this action turns into an asynchronous action. There is a limit of 60 minutes for the query to complete. You can use the wait for quer…

input.name: project_id
input.label: Project
input.hint: The project which contains the table.

input.name: query
input.label: Query
input.hint: Provide a valid SQL string to be executed. Use bind variables, e.g. id = @id, and the parameter field below to parameters inputs.

input.name: parameters
input.label: Parameters
input.hint: First provide the full name assigned to your bind variable in the WHERE condition. e.g. id Second, provide the actual parameter value. Parameter values can be static or datapills. Select the closest c…

input.name: output_schema
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Use this to manually define the columns returned in your query.

input.name: location
input.label: Location
input.hint: The geographic location where the job should run.

input.name: wait_for_query
input.label: Wait for query to complete?
input.hint: Set to true to wait for queries to run. This turns the action into asynchronous.

properties.name: projectId
properties.label: Project
properties.hint: Optional. The project which contains the dataset to load the data to.

properties.name: datasetId
properties.label: Dataset
properties.hint: Optional. The dataset which contains the table to load the query results to.

properties.name: tableId
properties.label: Table
properties.hint: Optional. The table to load the query results to.
